headline: PROP sector leads the market as CMC jumps 30.56% and EVER climbs 22.22%, while PF slides 20%
market_take: Today's coverage is dominated by strong upside in the PROP sector, highlighted by CMC (+30.56%) and EVER (+22.22%) with both also posting large 5‑day gains. The FOOD sector shows mixed signals, with F&D up 18.75% and XBIO down 12.5% amid a SET clarification filing. REITs see notable volume spikes (IMPACT, WHART) and a few capital‑change filings. Overall, trading activity is elevated across PROP, FOOD and REITs, suggesting both momentum opportunities and heightened volatility.
